lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the torso. Spacing is narrower and lines are more densely packed on the anterior (shoulder) section, becoming wider and more irregular across the mid-section and posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several vertical lines in the mid-torso and posterior regions are discontinuous, terminating mid-flank or fragmenting into discrete circular spots before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 6-8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior flank, situated in the space between the vertical lines and the junction of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A subset of spots on the lower flank align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric row parallel to the belly line.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white horizontal bands are visible on the lower forelimbs (fetlock/carpus region) and a distinct white patch is visible at the base of the throat.
